     # default ignore list for detailed views
     IGNORE = ('module', 'docuri', 'version_added', 'short_description', 'now_date', 'plainexamples', 'returndocs', 'collection')
 
+    _TTY_MACRO = re.compile(
+        r'(?<!\w)(?:'
+        r'(?P<simple>[IBMUC])\((?P<value>[^)]+)\)'
+        r'|(?P<link>[LR])\((?P<label>[^,)]+), *(?P<target>[^)]+)\)'
+        r'|(?P<rule>HORIZONTALLINE)(?!\w)'
+        r')'
+    )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tty_ify(cls, text):
+        def render(match):
+            if match.group('rule'):
+                return '\n-------------\n'
+            if match.group('link'):
+                label = match.group('label')
+                if match.group('link') == 'L':
+                    return '%s <%s>' % (label, match.group('target'))
+                return label
+            value = match.group('value')
+            kind = match.group('simple')
+            if kind in ('I', 'C'):
+                return "`%s'" % value
+            if kind == 'B':
+                return '*%s*' % value
+            if kind == 'M':
+                return '[%s]' % value
+            return value
+
+        return cls._TTY_MACRO.sub(render, text)
+
     def __init__(self, args):
 
         super(DocCLI, self).__init__(args)

+# Copyright: (c) 2026, Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+class TestDocCLITtyIfy(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_links_and_rule(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            DocCLI.tty_ify('L(Ansible,https://example.com) R(guide, reference) HORIZONTALLINE'),
+            'Ansible <https://example.com> guide \n-------------\n',
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('L(label, https://example.com) R(name,ref)'),
+                         'label <https://example.com> name')
+
+    def test_mixed_macros_and_plain_text(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            DocCLI.tty_ify('Use M(name), B(text), C(value), R(guide,ref), I(note) and U(url).'),
+            "Use [name], *text*, `value', guide, `note' and url.",
+        )
+
+    def test_non_macros_are_unchanged(self):
+        text = 'IBM(International Business Machines) and FL(foo,bar) HORIZONTALLINES'
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(text), text)
